tasks.description: Extract atomic notes from Vacation Master Plan v2 — information theory + null models merged spec (Zipf MLE, Shannon entropy cross-validation, entropy rate, excess entropy, burstiness, idiom detection), probing framework design, LMT integration tiers, and workstream convergence narrative
notes: 1 new note: pooling strategy choice over the time dimension determines what information probing experiments can access from hidden states
33 candidate claims already existed in vault from prior extraction — near-complete prior coverage confirmed
note_candidates: zipf_via_shannon_entropy cross-validates MLE Zipf estimate and is more robust for datasets < 10K tokens
ngram_idioms detects compositional phrases by comparing observed n-gram frequency to independence baseline (z-score > 3 or FDR p < 0.01)
burstiness CV distinguishes Poisson (CV=1), bursty (CV>1), and regular (CV<1) USV emission patterns
burstiness_by_context bridges information-theoretic analysis and LMT behavioral annotation
null models are prerequisite for interpreting information-theoretic metrics — without them Zipf and entropy rate are uninterpretable
conditional_entropy_by_lag (single token at lag k) is complementary to entropy_rate (contiguous history up to order k)
LMT-USV-Toolbox already implements WAV-behavioral synchronization — no need to build from scratch
probing heatmap of (layer × acoustic property) directly guides VQ-VAE layer selection
excess entropy I(past;future) distinguishes language-like structure from Markov chains
phase-randomized surrogates preserve autocorrelation but destroy higher-order structure — tests whether structure is just pairwise temporal correlation
HMM surrogate tests the hidden behavioral states hypothesis as alternative to compositional structure
